claims.evidence: Weight is not shown in any photo and cannot be determined remotely.
No standard certification or mark is visible in the report.
The report shows a gas cylinder but does not confirm it is for cooking gas.

risks.risk: Cylinder weight or amount of gas remaining is unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of the cylinder on a weighing scale showing its weight, or a clear image of the weight stamped on the collar.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an empty cylinder of unknown size.

risks.risk: Expiry date or last test date is unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the date stamped on the cylinder collar or body.
risks.if_unproven: Price as expired or untested, requiring revalidation before use.

risks.risk: Condition of the valve and seals is unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photo or short video of the valve, preferably with a soapy-water leak test showing no bubbles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as valve faulty or seals perished, not safe to connect without repair.

risks.risk: It is unclear whether the yellow and blue cylinders are one listing or separate items.
risks.proof: Photo showing both cylinders together in one frame, or written confirmation from the seller.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a single cylinder only.

risks.proof: Clear photo of any embossed branding or logo on the cylinder.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unbranded generic cylinder.

proof_requests: Photo of the cylinder on a weighing scale showing its weight.
Close-up photo of the expiry or last test date stamped on the cylinder.
Close-up photo or short video of the valve and seals, ideally with a leak test.
Clarification and photo showing whether the yellow and blue cylinders are one item or two.
Clear photo of any brand name or model marking on the cylinder.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a gas cylinder, so it can be priced at its worst case pending proof of weight, expiry, valve condition, and whether one or two cylinders are being sold.
